footer.subjectPlaceholder: Enter the subject of your message

respect_dignity.name: Equal dignity
respect_dignity.message: Before God, women and men have the same rights and equal dignity. Respecting equality means defending her freedom to choose and her right to be heard.

respect_consent.name: A freely given yes
respect_consent.message: If she cannot say no without fearing your reaction, what is the yes you hope for worth?

respect_boundaries.name: Respecting a no
respect_boundaries.message: Insisting after a no pressures her to give in. Her freedom to choose matters more than your disappointment. Accept her answer.

respect_empathy.name: In her shoes
respect_empathy.message: Imagine how you would feel in her place, then listen to her: your imagination cannot replace her experience.

respect_freedom.name: Love without control
respect_freedom.message: Going through her phone or forbidding her to see friends is controlling her life. If you feel jealous, talk about your feelings without asking her to give up her freedom.

respect_anger.name: The strength to stay calm
respect_anger.message: Respect also shows in what you choose not to do when you are angry.

respect_sexism.name: Standing up to sexism
respect_sexism.message: A joke that puts women down is still humiliating even if everyone laughs. You can tell your friends: “That puts her down. It’s not funny.”

respect_privacy.name: Respecting her privacy
respect_privacy.message: She trusted you with something personal. That trust never gave you the right to expose it.

respect_solidarity.name: Support without imposing
respect_solidarity.message: Helping her means making room for her to decide, not deciding for her.

respect_accountability.name: Owning your actions
respect_accountability.message: You will know you have changed when you respond differently to the same frustration.

respect_happiness.name: Her happiness
respect_happiness.message: Taking joy in seeing her thrive also means celebrating what she achieves without you.

respect_fantasy.name: Fantasy
respect_fantasy.message: Sex is not the most important thing in life. Tenderness, trust and closeness matter much more to the happiness you build together. Seek your own happiness and help her find hers and flourish.

respect_worth.name: Self-worth
respect_worth.message: Whether or not you have a sex life says nothing about your worth. You have nothing to prove.

respect_tenderness.name: Tenderness
respect_tenderness.message: Some moments of happiness take very little: someone who listens, a shared laugh, or company that makes you feel good.

respect_desire.name: Desire
respect_desire.message: Evil makes you believe that nothing matters more than your desire. Whatever you desire, without the wisdom of love it can lead you to folly and sorrow. Look with your heart: if you long to love, protect and respect the other person above all.

respect_love.name: Love
respect_love.message: The quality of a relationship also shows in how free both people are to be themselves, speak and say no.

respect_full_life.name: A full life
respect_full_life.message: Friendship, creating things, helping one another and the joy of learning can give your life as much meaning as love or sex.

respect_break_the_chain.name: Break the chain of rape culture
respect_break_the_chain.message: Downplaying unwanted sexual touching and harassment sustains rape culture. When this violence affects someone in your family, it shakes your life too. Don’t wait until it affects someone you love to act. Say no to sexual harassment, defend women’s right to live free from violence, and support those who speak up.

respect_no_manipulation.name: Say no to manipulation
respect_no_manipulation.message: Love is neither a program nor a game. Trying to lock someone in a gilded cage is folly: even a golden cage takes away their freedom. Love cannot be manipulated. If you love someone, respect their freedom to choose.

respect_no_perfidy.name: Say no to betrayal
respect_no_perfidy.message: Too often, what we say and share among men disrespects women’s privacy. A degrading sexual remark or an intimate photo shared without consent makes it harder for women to feel safe. Change your heart: choose true love, the kind that respects their privacy even when they aren’t there.

respect_protect_without_control.name: Protection without control
respect_protect_without_control.message: If you want to protect her, ask what she needs. Deciding for her can take away the freedom you meant to defend.

respect_trust_not_debt.name: Trust is not a debt
respect_trust_not_debt.message: If you say “after everything I’ve done for you” to get a yes, you turn generosity into pressure.

respect_respect_in_absence.name: Respect in her absence
respect_respect_in_absence.message: If a friend shares an intimate photo without her consent, don’t pass it on. Tell your friend to delete it. Respect also shows in what you refuse to condone.

respect_listen_first.name: Listen before defending yourself
respect_listen_first.message: If she says you scared her, don’t start by explaining why she shouldn’t have been afraid. Listen to what she experienced.

respect_faith_and_freedom.name: Faith and freedom
respect_faith_and_freedom.message: Don’t invoke God to get something she does not want to give. Her conscience and freedom deserve as much respect as yours.

respect_make_amends.name: Making amends without demands
respect_make_amends.message: You can acknowledge the harm you caused without asking her to forgive you. The first sign of change is respecting the distance she asks for.

respect_integrity.name: Integrity
respect_integrity.message: Keep your word even when no one is watching. If you can no longer keep a commitment, say so honestly.

respect_humility.name: Humility
respect_humility.message: When someone corrects you, first ask what you can learn. Admitting a mistake does not lessen your worth.

respect_healthy_boundaries.name: Courage to set boundaries
respect_healthy_boundaries.message: You can say no calmly, even to your friends. Respecting others does not mean accepting what hurts you.

respect_share_responsibilities.name: Sharing responsibilities
respect_share_responsibilities.message: Do your share of everyday work without waiting for her to remind you. Planning and organizing are work too.

respect_celebrate_success.name: Joy in her success
respect_celebrate_success.message: Celebrate her success without comparing it to yours. Her talent takes nothing away from yours.

respect_consideration.name: Consideration
respect_consideration.message: Before joking about something vulnerable she shared with you, remember why she told you: she trusted you.

respect_ask_for_help.name: Strength to ask for help
respect_ask_for_help.message: When you no longer know how to act without hurting someone, speak to a person you trust. Asking for help means taking your actions seriously.

respect_share_peace.name: Seek peace and share it
respect_share_peace.message: Seek peace in your words and actions. When conflict arises, listen before you answer and refuse to humiliate others. Sharing peace also means setting boundaries when someone causes harm.

respect_gods_light.name: God’s light
respect_gods_light.message: Keep God’s love as your light and His wisdom in your heart.

respect_valiant_hero.name: Valiant hero
respect_valiant_hero.message: God will give you strength: He is with you. Valiant hero, don’t let past mistakes hold you captive. Build your life with justice, faith and hope, despite the struggles.

first_steps.name: LIFT YOUR HEAD
first_steps.message: You are a wonderful creature! The first step is always the most important.

move_now.name: MOVE NOW!
move_now.message: Action creates momentum. Keep moving forward, don't stop!

break_silence.name: BREAK THE SILENCE
break_silence.message: Your voice matters. Express yourself, make yourself heard. The world awaits you!

persevere.name: PERSEVERE
persevere.message: Perseverance beats talent. Keep going, you're on the right path!

release.name: RELEASE
release.message: Free yourself from your chains. Let go of what holds you back.

stand_up.name: STAND UP!
stand_up.message: Get up! You are a warrior, a champion. Don't stay down!

jesus_loves.name: YOU ARE LOVED
jesus_loves.message: Jesus loves you as you are. His love is unconditional and eternal.

halfway.name: HALFWAY THERE
halfway.message: You've come halfway! Keep going, the best is yet to come!

combo_master.name: COMBO MASTER
combo_master.message: Extraordinary combo! You've mastered the art of connection!

warrior.name: WARRIOR OF LIGHT
warrior.message: You are a warrior! Your courage inspires the world around you.

unstoppable.name: UNSTOPPABLE
unstoppable.message: Nothing can stop you! You are a force of nature!

master.name: ABSOLUTE MASTER
master.message: You've reached supreme mastery! You are extraordinary!

ultimate_trophy.name: ULTIMATE TROPHY
ultimate_trophy.message: MAXIMUM level reached! You are an absolute champion! Discover Emmanuel's inclusive universe.
